description: Header file defining functions and includes related to Lua configuration within the lighttpd server, including load and push table functions.

methods.name: li_config_lua_load
methods.description: Loads Lua configuration from a specified file into the server context, with options for setup and arguments.

methods.name: li_lua_push_action_table
methods.description: Pushes the action table into the Lua state for configuration purposes.

methods.name: li_lua_push_setup_table
methods.description: Pushes the setup table into the Lua state for configuration purposes.
